naming: icons/<desktop id without .desktop>.<ext>; symbolic/<icon name>.svg (freedesktop icon name as GTK looks it up)
notes: Symbolic SVGs are monochrome templates: GTK recolours them to the widget's foreground colour; paths with class="error" or "warning" take GTK's error/warning colours (observed: battery-level-0 drawn #cc0000).
Icon lookup order in the session: Antumbra -> Adwaita -> hicolor (incl. phosh's built-in resource icons); where two exist, the earlier one is what the session shows.
